about: Items the game has that the main data source (th.gl) does not list. Merged by forge.gamedata(); never overrides th.gl.

armor.name: Blackstone Hood - Heat

set_effects.2: Upon dealing Elemental DMG, gain 1 stack(s) of Warm Sensation (Elemental DMG +2%) for 2s. Triggers 1 time every 2s, up to a maximum of 5 stacks.
set_effects.3: When the temperature is above 30°C, you gain Passion status (Elemental DMG +10%). For every additional degree above that, gain Elemental DMG +0.5%, up to 20%.
set_effects.4: At 5 stack(s) of Warm Sensation, the environmental temperature rises by 20°C, the DMG bonus provided by the Passion status is doubled, and its cap is increased to 40%.

armor.note: Stats copied from the regular Blackstone piece (same base item).
